title: Pokémon Podcast
author: Emily
description: This podcast talks all about Pokémon! In each episode I give all the details of a Pokemon like appearances, attacks, personality, and give my opinion. Both Pokémon experts and noobs can enjoy this podcast! P.S. the majority of this podcast revolves around the Pokémon anime. P.S. The first half of my gen 1 episodes are SUPER cringe. You have been warned! For additional posts see my instagram: emilybean2024
